scope_note: Illustrative, source-qualified pathways, not a claim that all government transactions or reporting obligations have been mapped. Applicable rules depend on the agency, fund, fiscal year and transaction.

statuses.documented: Described in an existing Atlas chapter and cited source; current applicability still depends on later rules.
statuses.verify_current: Relevant source or practice identified, but its current operative detail must be checked before treating it as a rule.
statuses.interpretation: Analytical connection inferred from multiple records, not a quoted or mandatory exchange.

items.name: Appropriation in the GAA
items.definition: Legal authorization for expenditure for a specified purpose and period; it is not a payment or, in every case, a separate release document.

items.name: Special Allotment Release Order
items.definition: An allotment release instrument used where the GAA itself does not serve as the allotment order.

items.name: Notice of Cash Allocation
items.definition: Disbursement authority setting a limit for payments through the applicable servicing-bank arrangement; not a transfer of cash to the agency.

items.name: Recording an obligation
items.definition: Charging a commitment to the applicable allotment, distinguished from later acceptance and payment.

items.name: Obligation Request and Status
items.definition: Document supporting and tracking a particular obligation and subsequent adjustments and payment information.

items.name: Inspection and Acceptance Report
items.definition: Records inspection and acceptance of delivered goods, distinguished from an obligation or a disbursement.

items.name: Acceptance of delivery
items.definition: Recognition that delivery was inspected and accepted; may establish an account payable, not a payment.

items.name: Disbursement Voucher
items.definition: Document containing certifications and approval of a claim for payment; an approved voucher alone does not establish bank settlement.

items.name: List of Due and Demandable Accounts Payable with Advice to Debit Account
items.definition: Agency instruction to the servicing bank listing payees and amounts, not by itself proof that the payees were credited.

items.name: Bank settlement
items.definition: The bank's payment to a payee, which can occur on a different date from the agency's recording of the disbursement.

items.name: Registry of Appropriations and Allotments
items.definition: Agency budget-unit registry of appropriations and allotments, not a double-entry accounting ledger.

items.name: Registries of Allotments, Obligations and Disbursements
aliases: Registry of Allotments Obligations and Disbursements
items.definition: Budget-unit records of allotments, obligations, disbursements and related balances by applicable classification.

items.name: Registries of Budget, Utilization and Disbursements
items.definition: Budget-unit registries for specified funds that do not use the ordinary DBM allotment route.

items.name: Registry of Allotments and Notice of Cash Allocation
items.definition: Accounting-unit record of allotment, cash allocation and use of cash authority.

items.name: Journal Entry Voucher
items.definition: Document for recording accounting entries; distinct from agency budget-unit registries.

items.name: Inter-agency fund-transfer agreement
items.definition: Agreement documenting the source and implementing agencies' respective responsibilities for a transfer.

items.name: Inter-agency fund transfer
items.definition: Transfer to an implementing entity with accounting, use, reporting and liquidation requirements; cash transfer and reportable disbursement may occur at different times.

items.name: Transfer utilization and liquidation reports
items.definition: Reports from the implementing agency showing eligible actual project expenditure and the remaining balance.

items.name: Budget Accountability Report
items.definition: Physical/performance accountability reports within the BFAR family, separate from the numbered Financial Accountability Reports.

items.name: Budget Execution Document
items.definition: Budget execution plans submitted by agencies, including financial, physical and cash-disbursement programming; plans are not actual expenditure reports.

items.name: Government Accounting Manual for National Government Agencies
items.definition: COA manual covering accounting rules and procedures (Volume I), forms and records (Volume II), and the Revised Chart of Accounts (Volume III); later issuances may change particular provisions.

items.name: Unified Accounts Code Structure
items.definition: Common coding structure for classification of government financial information; a code is not an identifier for a unique payment or voucher.

items.name: Unified Reporting System
items.definition: DBM reporting channel for prescribed budget execution and accountability documents, subject to the applicable rollout and reporting circulars.

items.name: Government agency financial statements
items.definition: Accrual-based financial statements produced from accounting records; their measurement basis differs from an agency's budget execution FAR reports.

items.name: Financial Accountability Report
items.definition: A numbered financial reporting form within the Budget and Financial Accountability Reports family, including reports on execution, funds, obligations, disbursements and receipts.

items.name: Budget and Financial Accountability Reports
items.definition: Family of prescribed budget and financial accountability returns; includes the BAR and FAR forms identified by the governing joint circular.

items.name: FAR No. 1 — Statement of Appropriations, Allotments, Obligations, Disbursements and Balances
aliases: Statement of Appropriations Allotments Obligations Disbursements and Balances
items.definition: Quarterly report comparing appropriations, allotments, obligations, disbursements and balances for the applicable agency, funding and program classifications.

items.name: FAR No. 1-A — Summary by Object of Expenditures
items.definition: Quarterly companion of FAR 1 presenting amounts by object of expenditure.

items.name: FAR No. 1-B — List of Allotments and Sub-Allotments
items.definition: Quarterly list of allotments and sub-allotments.

items.name: FAR No. 1-C — Inter-Agency Fund Transfers
aliases: Statement of Obligations Disbursements Liquidations and Balances for Inter-agency Fund Transfers
items.definition: Quarterly statement of obligations, disbursements, liquidations and balances related to inter-agency fund transfers.

items.name: FAR No. 2 — Off-Budget Fund Utilization
items.definition: Quarterly budget, utilization, disbursement and balance report for specified off-budget funds.

items.name: FAR No. 2-A — Off-Budget Funds by Object
items.definition: Companion presentation of off-budget fund execution by object of expenditure; confirm fields against the governing form.

items.name: FAR No. 3 — Aging of Due and Demandable Obligations
items.definition: Annual account of unpaid due-and-demandable obligations by age.

items.name: FAR No. 4 — Monthly Report of Disbursements
items.definition: Monthly report of disbursements by type of disbursement authority.

items.name: FAR No. 5 — Quarterly Report of Revenue and Other Receipts
items.definition: Quarterly report of revenue and other receipts by fund cluster.

items.name: FAR No. 6 — Trust Receipts
aliases: Statement of Approved Budgets Utilizations Disbursements and Balances for Trust Receipts
items.definition: Quarterly report on approved budgets, utilization, disbursements and balances for specified trust receipts.

items.name: BAR No. 1 — Quarterly Physical Report of Operations
items.definition: Quarterly report of physical outputs against targets, distinct from a financial disbursement report.

items.name: Review of an additional NCA request
items.definition: DBM service decision for requests for additional cash allocation; required supporting reports must be checked against the current Citizen's Charter and applicable circulars.

items.name: Audit finding or action
items.definition: COA audit work may examine agency financial records and reports; the individual finding depends on the evidence and applicable rules.

items.name: COA Circular No. 94-013
items.definition: 1994 COA issuance concerning the grant, utilization and liquidation of funds transferred to implementing agencies. Verify the current interaction with later issuances before operational use.
